_README: Template for the broker clock profile declaration. Copy this to
clock-profile.declaration.json, replace EVERY placeholder with dated
The offsets below are NOT this account's offsets. They are the common
EET/EEST broker pattern (UTC+2 winter, UTC+3 summer) shown so the shape is
obvious. The repository README records that the local terminal reports ticks
approximately three hours ahead of UTC, which is consistent with EEST but
does not establish the historical rule. Attest it before trusting it.
Segment boundaries are deliberately placed at 00:00 UTC on the SUNDAY of the
EU DST change, not at the 01:00 UTC change instant. The offset change creates
a one-hour window the EA cannot resolve to exactly one UTC instant; parking
that window inside the weekend closure means no real M1 bar ever lands in it.
The build command fails if any dead zone falls while the market is open.

anchors.attested_by: REPLACE: independent UTC source, e.g. ats-backend NTP reading taken in the same second. The terminal's own TimeGMT is NOT acceptable here and is rejected.
